name: Doyen de la cité
description: A very heavy-set elderly male Yautja chief with an enormous wide ochre cranial dome, heavy textured jowls and short silver-black dread tendrils. Thick deep plum brocade long coat, copper-colored layered belt plates, compact bone shoulder rings. Both hands open in a calm welcoming gesture close to his sides; large clawed feet and full robe hem visible. Distinct broad round silhouette, realistic anatomy.
